title: 新品很多，怎样判断该把资源投向哪条产品线？
topic: 根据消费趋势和产品表现确定创新投入优先级

source.title: Connecting with consumers
source.type: 雀巢 2025 年报中的消费者洞察与产品创新业务章节
source.context: Nestlé 官方业务材料；本课练习围绕实际业务沟通任务。
source.captureMethod: Reader-captured excerpt from the linked official company source; original URL verified in the web reader. Direct HTTP status was not checked for this capture.
paragraphs: Nestlé draws on data-driven consumer insights to develop innovation pipelines of preferred products. We operate with agility and flexibility to quickly respond to emerging trends, such as modern cooking, new flavors and textures, frequent small meals and nutrition goals across life stages. We utilize our R&D (Research and Development) capabilities to develop differentiated products that taste great, hit appropriate price points and exceed consumer expectations.
We scale promising innovations boldly, using clever marketing to raise awareness of our products and gain share.

Within the food category we are pursuing growth by expanding our portfolio of products that make the preparation of tasty meals easier using modern devices. As household penetration of air fryers continued to rise in 2025, Nestlé rapidly rolled out its innovative Maggi air fryer range of flavors and recipe mixes across all zones to a total of 27 countries at year’s end.

In Europe, Maggi launched Saucy Noodles with recipes such as Japanese Teriyaki and Pad Thai, helping Asian food lovers prepare a delicious small meal in minutes. Fueled by this initiative, noodles became the largest growth driver for our food category in 2025.
translations: 雀巢利用数据驱动的消费者洞察，规划消费者偏好的创新产品线。公司保持灵活，快速响应新趋势，例如现代烹饪、新口味和新质地、频繁少量进食，以及不同人生阶段的营养目标。公司运用研发能力开发有差异化的产品：既要美味、价格合适，也要超出消费者的预期。
公司会大胆扩大有潜力的创新产品的规模，并用有针对性的营销提高产品知名度、争取市场份额。
在食品品类中，雀巢正通过扩大适配现代厨具的产品组合来寻求增长，让人们更方便地做出美味餐食。随着 2025 年家用空气炸锅的普及率持续上升，雀巢迅速将创新的 Maggi 空气炸锅调味系列和食谱调料包推广到各个区域；截至年底，已进入 27 个国家。
在欧洲，Maggi 推出了日式照烧和泰式炒河粉等口味的浓酱面，帮助喜爱亚洲风味的消费者在几分钟内准备一份美味的小餐。受这一举措带动，面条成为雀巢食品品类在 2025 年最大的增长来源。

notes.meaning: 利用消费者数据和观察来判断需求。
notes.explain: consumer insights 是消费者偏好、需求或行为带来的业务发现。
notes.example: Data-driven consumer insights shaped the new product brief.

notes.explain: scale 是扩大产品推广规模；promising 表示有潜力。
notes.example: We will scale the pilot if repeat demand holds.

notes.phrase: household penetration of air fryers continued to rise in 2025
notes.meaning: 2025 年家用空气炸锅普及率继续上升。

scenario.title: 新品评审：从趋势信号到资源优先级
english: Your food team has several product ideas but budget for only one launch this quarter.
Household use of air fryers is rising, and shoppers are looking for quick meal options.
Recommend a product direction, explain the consumer signal, and suggest what results to review after launch.
chinese: 食品团队有多个新品想法，但本季度只能支持一个上市。
家用空气炸锅的使用率正在上升，消费者也在寻找快捷餐食。
请建议一个产品方向，说明消费者信号，并提出上市后要复盘哪些结果。

firstAttempt.prompt: 模拟提案：公司同时评估几条新品线，资源有限。请用英语说明应优先考虑什么市场信号、建议投入哪个方向，并提出如何验证增长。
firstAttempt.sample: Household use of air fryers continued to rise in 2025. Nestlé’s 2025 report says the Maggi air-fryer range reached 27 countries. I recommend prioritizing markets where adoption is still growing. Before expanding further, we should review trial, repeat purchase, and category growth.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先报告市场趋势，再提出产品和市场优先级，最后说明扩大前要复核的指标。

words.example: We used consumer insights to identify demand for quick meals.
words.translation: 我们利用消费者洞察发现了快捷餐食的需求。
words.note: insight 指帮助团队理解消费者需求或行为的发现。

words.meaning: 创新产品储备；创新产品线
words.example: The team is building an innovation pipeline for smaller households.
words.translation: 团队正在为小家庭开发一系列创新产品。
words.note: 指正在研发、评估或准备推出的创新项目。

words.example: We should scale the product after repeat purchases confirm demand.
words.translation: 在复购数据确认需求后，我们应该扩大这款产品的推广。
words.note: 在商业语境中常指扩大产品、服务或运营规模。

taskPhrases.collocation: report a market trend before recommending investment
taskPhrases.example: Household use of air fryers continued to rise in 2025.
taskPhrases.translation: 2025 年，空气炸锅的家庭使用率持续上升。

taskPhrases.example: I recommend prioritizing markets where air-fryer adoption is still growing.
taskPhrases.translation: 我建议优先进入空气炸锅普及率仍在上升的市场。

taskPhrases.example: Our commercial goal is to gain share in the quick-meal category.
taskPhrases.translation: 我们的业务目标是在快捷餐食品类提升市场份额。

structure.original: We scale promising innovations boldly, using clever marketing to raise awareness of our products and gain share.
analysis: 主句 We scale promising innovations 先交代行动：扩大有潜力的创新产品。
using… 是补充方式，说明用什么办法推广。
to raise… and gain… 并列说明营销希望达到的两个结果。
structure.transfer: We will scale the meal-kit pilot, using local partnerships to raise awareness and gain share.

rewrite.bad: We have many ideas, so let’s launch all of them.
rewrite.good: Household use of air fryers continued to rise in 2025. Nestlé’s 2025 report says the Maggi air-fryer range reached 27 countries. I recommend prioritizing markets where adoption is still growing. Before expanding, we should review trial, repeat purchase, and category growth.
rewrite.translation: 2025 年，空气炸锅的家庭使用率持续上升。雀巢 2025 年年报显示，Maggi 空气炸锅产品线已进入 27 个国家。我建议优先考虑普及率仍在上升的市场。进一步扩大前，我们应复核试用率、复购率和品类增长。
rewrite.pattern: Household use of [product] is rising. I recommend prioritizing [product/market]. Before expanding, review [measures].

cloze.prompt: Household ______ of air fryers continued to rise in 2025.
cloze.why: household penetration 指产品在家庭中的普及率。

cloze.prompt: The company plans to ______ promising innovations.
cloze.why: scale a product 表示扩大产品推广规模。

cloze.prompt: The new range helped us gain ______ in the category.
cloze.why: gain share 表示提升市场份额。

dictation.label: 听写 1
dictation.text: We scale promising innovations boldly, using clever marketing to raise awareness of our products and gain share.
dictation.why: 听清 using 引出的推广方式，以及后面并列的两个目标。

apply.prompt: 家用空气炸锅的普及率在 2025 年持续上升。
apply.sample: Household penetration of air fryers continued to rise in 2025.

dictation.label: 听写 2
dictation.text: In Europe, Maggi launched Saucy Noodles with recipes such as Japanese Teriyaki and Pad Thai.
dictation.why: 注意 such as 后面举出的口味例子。

apply.prompt: 上市后，我们要比较试用率、复购率和品类增长。
apply.sample: After launch, we should compare trial, repeat purchase, and category growth.

translationPractice.prompt: 2025 年，空气炸锅的家庭使用率持续上升。
translationPractice.answer: Household use of air fryers continued to rise in 2025.
translationPractice.why: 先用市场趋势说明新品方向的机会。

translationPractice.prompt: 我建议优先进入空气炸锅普及率仍在上升的市场。
translationPractice.answer: I recommend prioritizing markets where air-fryer adoption is still growing.
translationPractice.why: recommend prioritizing 直接表达资源有限时的优先选择。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们的业务目标是在快捷餐食品类提升市场份额。
translationPractice.answer: Our commercial goal is to gain share in the quick-meal category.
translationPractice.why: gain share 表达提升品类或市场份额；这里说的是目标，不是已经实现的结果。

choice.prompt: 团队只能支持一个新品方向。哪种建议同时说明了依据和下一步验证方式？
options: We should launch every idea so no opportunity is missed.
Air-fryer use is rising, so I recommend prioritizing the range and reviewing trial and repeat purchases before expanding.
This product feels exciting, and we should scale it immediately.
choice.why: 第二条把消费趋势、优先选择和后续验证连起来，没有把趋势直接当作已验证销量。

output.prompt: 团队发现消费者开始偏好更方便的早餐，但目前只有概念测试。请用英文建议优先开发一种产品，并说明上市前后各要验证什么。
output.sample: Consumer research points to demand for convenient breakfasts. I recommend prioritizing the ready-to-eat option for a small pilot. Before launch, we should confirm the target price and taste preference; after launch, we can review trial, repeat purchase, and margin before expanding.
check: 说出支持产品选择的消费者信号
明确建议优先投入的方向
区分上市前验证与上市后指标

blockers: 人工听审音频，逐条确认与文字一致并检查语速、停顿和截断。
真实账号进度保存和生产环境逐期验收。
